description: Geospatial Approach to Local Level Multi-Hazard Assessment in Malawi: Chikwawa and Nsanje Districts is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Science Data Bank. The datasets support a study on an approach for assessing and quantifying probabilities of occurrence, exposure, vulnerability and capacities required to calculate levels of disaster risk associated with common hazards and their implications on land-based sources of livelihoods across Chikwawa and Nsanje districts in Malawi using a combination of deterministic risk assessment and geospatial techniques. Coverage: Malawi. The portal files it under the publisher Science Data Bank. Its tags are Earth science, Natural science related engineering and technology, Environmental science and resources science and technology, Others, Hazards. The repository dates the deposit 2024; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Non Commercial 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
